stories.title: Heterogeneous memory boundaries belong in the compile-time type system
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how encoding hardware memory boundaries directly into a programming language's type system prevents runtime device memory errors at compile time.

stories.title: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri as a sovereign open-weight model
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how Aleph Alpha built Kolibri, a 78B mixture-of-experts model designed for sovereign and regulated environments. You will learn about their automated training pipeline and domain specialization approach.

stories.title: Adversarial co-evolution reveals scale paradoxes in autonomous agents
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how co-evolutionary quality-diversity algorithms uncover critical security vulnerabilities and failure modes in autonomous language agents before deployment.

stories.title: Go expands architecture specific simd support to arm64 and wasm
stories.why_read: Learn how Go designs accessible, low-level SIMD intrinsics across multiple architectures using compiler optimizations. This post explains the architecture-specific SIMD infrastructure and its ergonomic API design.

stories.title: PostgreSQL 19 enables lock contention visibility by default
stories.why_read: Learn about key observability and monitoring updates in PostgreSQL 19, starting with default lock contention logging to quickly identify transaction bottlenecks.

stories.title: Disposable overfit inference engines outperform general runtimes on fixed hardware
stories.why_read: Read this to understand why specialized inference runtimes outperform general-purpose engines on consumer hardware. You will learn the architectural trade-offs between runtime portability and hyper-specific hardware optimizations.

stories.title: Fusing Python with GraalVM enables high performance server applications
stories.why_read: Learn how Pyronaut integrates the Python runtime with Micronaut and Netty on GraalVM to achieve significantly higher throughput and lower latency. You will understand how combining Python syntax with JVM optimizations bridges the performance gap for server-side Python.

stories.title: Bounding language model hallucinations using Merlin-Arthur protocols
stories.why_read: Learn how to rigorously verify whether a language model truly utilized its source documents and flag ungrounded responses. This work provides a formal protocol for bounding hallucinations and enabling models to reliably abstain.

stories.title: Micro-VM sandbox provides lightweight isolation for agentic workloads
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how NVX provides fast, hardware-enforced isolation for untrusted agentic workloads. You will learn how it builds on OpenVMM and Nanvix research to deliver a cross-platform sandboxing environment.

stories.title: Llama.cpp introduces decision models for single pass option scoring
stories.why_read: Understand how decision models evaluate choices in a single forward pass instead of generating text token-by-token. You will learn how to leverage the new llama.cpp endpoint for fast request routing, agent verification, and scoring.

stories.title: System-wide AI agent profiling and monitoring with eBPF
stories.why_read: Read this to discover how to achieve granular system-level observability for autonomous AI agents using eBPF. It provides a lightweight way to inspect process behavior, file changes, and network activity when agent logs fall short.

stories.title: Predicting LLM memory requirements and boot feasibility before renting GPUs
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how to accurately predict model memory footprints and diagnose common boot failures before renting expensive GPU hardware.

stories.title: Declarative event-driven workflow automation using Kubernetes custom resources
stories.why_read: Learn how KubeZap enables secure, declarative workflow automation inside Kubernetes without external dependencies or vendor lock-in.

stories.title: Building a dedicated query matching engine for Firestore
stories.why_read: Understand the architectural bottlenecks of repurposing full-text search engines for database change streams and how Firestore designed a dedicated query matcher.

stories.title: Long-context LLM decode inference shifts memory bottlenecks to KV cache
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the exact crossover points where KV cache bandwidth overtakes model weights during LLM generation. It establishes a unified analytical framework for evaluating long-context optimization strategies across modern hardware.

stories.title: Modeling durable agent harnesses as statecharts that checkpoint each step
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how statecharts and step-level checkpoints enable crash-resilient execution for large language model agents. You will learn how to structure tool environments and tasks so interrupted operations can seamlessly recover from storage.

stories.title: Fair PostgreSQL job queue scheduling prevents noisy neighbour delays
stories.why_read: Learn why standard FIFO queues in PostgreSQL create latency spikes for multi-tenant workloads and how to implement fair round-robin job scheduling.

stories.title: Open source implementation of DeepSeek Elastic Compute sandboxes
stories.why_read: Learn how Fireagent adapts DeepSeek Elastic Compute architecture to manage stateful, isolated microVM sandboxes using Firecracker. It offers a practical design for safely orchestrating AI coding assistants and reinforcement learning evaluation workloads.

stories.title: Safely integrating C++ memory management with Postgres extensions
stories.why_read: Understand the critical safety pitfalls when mixing Postgres's setjmp-based error handling and MemoryContexts with C++ RAII destructors and exceptions.

stories.title: How recurring network maintenance exposed six cascading bugs
stories.why_read: Read this post to understand how routine network partitions triggered cascading failures across glibc, OCaml concurrency libraries, and Kafka clients. You will learn how layered system bugs can mask one another during failure recovery in distributed environments.

stories.title: Pipelining local language model inference between Mac and iPhone
stories.why_read: Learn how to offload layer computation and attention caching to a tethered iPhone over USB-C, achieving faster prompt prefill and expanded context windows for local 27B models.

stories.title: Using roofline analysis to optimize DeepSeek-V3 parallelism on Hopper
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how roofline analysis can predict distributed communication bottlenecks and guide parallelism choices without expensive full-cluster benchmarking.
